van_de: Xe dap dien kho phan biet voi xe may dien
quyet_dinh: Dua vao cau hinh khung va bo dap: xe co khung/ban dap xe dap xep bicycle; xe dang co dang xe tay ga/xe may xep motorbike; neu khong du dau hieu thi chon lop co co so nhat va giu can_review.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 2 va 4.3: them dau hieu khung/ban dap; khong dung rieng ten goi hoac diem conf de quyet lop.

van_de: Xe may chen day gan camera: tung xe hay ignore_region
quyet_dinh: Ve rieng tung xe khi nhin tach duoc than/banh va chieu xe; chi dung mot ignore_region cho khoang cum khong the tach vat hoac vat cao duoi 20 px.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 4.1.6: ap cung nguong 20 px; khong bo qua xe ro chi vi anh dong.

van_de: Hang hoa nhô khoi xe ba gac/xe dap
quyet_dinh: Box xe gom phan xe va hang gan lien; neu hang roi/nhô qua 20% chieu dai xe thi khong mo rong box xe de om hang. Mask chi theo bien nhin thay cua xe va bo phan hang roi.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 4.1.5 va 4.2: bo sung cach xu ly hang nhô, giu xe va hang thanh doi tuong rieng neu hang la vat doc lap co trong taxonomy.

van_de: Nguoi ngoi trong tuk-tuk bi mui/khung che
quyet_dinh: Giu box person rieng neu phan nguoi nhin thay uoc tinh tu 20% tro len; duoi nguong thi khong gan, truong hop sat nguong tick can_review. Chi ve phan nhin thay.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 4.1.2: neu ro cach uoc tinh nguong che va cach xu ly sat nguong.

van_de: Kinh/cua so trong mask xe va nguoi nhin qua kinh
quyet_dinh: Kinh va cua so la phan cua mask xe; nguoi nhin thay qua kinh van co mask person rieng tren phan nhin thay, khong hap nhap vao mask xe.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 4.2: lam ro kinh thuoc xe nhung doi tuong nguoi van tach polygon.

van_de: Box xe chong nhau trong anh toi
quyet_dinh: Khong gop xe thanh mot box. Giu moi box rieng khi nhan ra duoc tung xe; neu khong tach duoc thi dung ignore_region theo muc 4.1.6.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 4.1 va 4.2: khong gop box/polygon cua hai xe; chi ignore vung khong the tach.

van_de: Dat nguong conf toi thieu de chap nhan box may
quyet_dinh: Khong dat nguong conf lam dieu kien tu dong chap nhan. Conf chi de sap thu tu review; moi box van phai duoc kiem tra lop, vat that va bien box.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 3: nhac lai conf chi la thong tin uu tien, khong thay the review bang mat.

van_de: Box #30 car trung len tuk-tuk da co box #29 three_wheeler
quyet_dinh: Xoa box car du thua; giu tuk-tuk la three_wheeler. Da xuat ban sua QC cho img_004.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 2 va 4.3: them ca model nham xe ba banh thanh car; kiem tra box trung truoc khi chap nhan.

van_de: Box #20 three_wheeler conf 0.18 duoc tick can_review
quyet_dinh: Khong coi conf thap la ly do tu dong xoa; kiem tra hinh dang xe va nguong kich thuoc, giu can_review khi lop van chua chac.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 3 va 4.3: can_review ghi nhan bat dinh ve quy tac/lop; conf chi uu tien thu tu xem.

van_de: review_stats tu dong danh dau 2 bay lot, trong khi hoc vien ghi da sua ca wrong_class va missing, coach da xac nhan
quyet_dinh: Giu so lieu may co the tai lap (10/12) de bao cao; doi chieu tung trap_key voi anh va annotation da export truoc khi ket luan. Ghi ro bat dong so lieu, khong tu sua so dem neu chua co doi chieu doc lap.
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Quy trinh calibration: neu thong ke bay khong khop viec sua nhan, doi chieu anh goc, traps_key va ban export; bao cao ca hai ket qua.
